title: Pivot Table Online – Summarize CSV or Excel | OpenAnyDoc
description: Make a pivot table from a CSV or Excel file in your browser: pick a row field, an optional column field and a count, sum or average. No upload.
heading: Pivot Table Maker: Summarize a CSV Fast
subtitle: Drop a CSV or Excel file, pick the fields and see the totals at once; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Make a pivot table in your browser: open a CSV or Excel file, choose a row field, optionally a field across the top, and the count, sum or average of a number column. The matrix of totals updates as soon as you change a choice, counts only the rows your filters show, and downloads as CSV. Excel files open their first sheet. Nothing is uploaded.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is opened by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: Updates at once
features.text: Change a field or the calculation and the totals are redrawn straight away.

features.title: Works offline
features.text: Once this page has loaded, it keeps working without an internet connection.

stepsTitle: How it works: make a pivot table

steps.title: Open your file
steps.text: Drop a CSV or Excel file, choose it, paste CSV into the paste box, or try one of the samples.

steps.title: Choose the fields
steps.text: Pick the row field, optionally a column field across the top, and count, sum or average of a number column.

steps.title: Filter to narrow it
steps.text: Filter the table and the pivot uses only the rows that are shown.

steps.title: Download the pivot
steps.text: Save the matrix of totals as a CSV file.

handles: Input: CSV files, and Excel .xlsx and .xls files (the first sheet).
Rows: one field down the side.
Columns: an optional field across the top.
Values: count of rows, or sum or average of a number column.
Filters: only the filtered rows are counted.
Download: the pivot as a CSV file.
limits: One row field and one column field; no nested levels.
The pivot downloads as CSV, not as an Excel pivot table.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your browser reads the file and adds up the totals on your device; nothing is sent to a server.

faq.question: How do I make a pivot table from a CSV?
faq.answer: Open the file, choose the field for the rows, optionally one for the columns, then the calculation and the number column. The matrix appears at once.

faq.question: What can the pivot calculate?
faq.answer: The count of rows, or the sum or average of a number column. Minimums, maximums and percentages are not offered.

faq.question: Can I pivot only part of the data?
faq.answer: Yes. Filter the table first; the pivot counts only the rows your filters show and updates when they change.

faq.question: Can I use an Excel file?
faq.answer: Yes. Its first sheet opens as the table.

faq.question: How do I save the pivot table?
faq.answer: Download it as a CSV file, which opens in Excel, Google Sheets or any spreadsheet.

faq.question: How do I make a pivot table without Excel?
faq.answer: Google Sheets and LibreOffice Calc both make pivot tables for free, and OpenAnyDoc makes one in your browser from a CSV or Excel file. Choose the row field, an optional column field and a count, sum or average, then download the totals as CSV; nothing is uploaded.
